subject: Upfront structure for 24-month commitment — split billing & escalator options
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@nimbushealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: 24-month prepay ask — discount & billing split

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Nimbus is keen to move to a 24-month committed plan, but procurement has two requests they need clarified before we get legal involved: 1) can Redwood provide a 30–35% term discount for a 24-month upfront commitment, and 2) whether we can split the upfront invoice across two annual invoices (we'd prefer 60% year 1 / 40% year 2) to simplify their FY planning. They also asked about an annual escalator — they proposed a 3% CPI-style increase in year 2 tied to our renewal.

I attached the SOW they shared for context (Nimbus_SOW_v2.pdf). Can you outline options (pricing/contract language) and any constraints on split billing?

Sandeep
Director, Procurement
Nimbus Health
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@nimbushealth.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay ask — discount & billing split

Hi Sandeep — great to hear Nimbus is ready to commit. Quick answers and options below: 

- Discount: standard scale for 24-month upfront is 20–28% depending on committed ARR and payment timing. For larger ARR (> $1.2M ARR net new) we can move to 30% but that requires finance approval.
- Billing split: we can accommodate split invoicing (e.g., 60/40) but two constraints: a) revenue recognition rules will still treat the payment as prepaid revenue to be deferred across the service period, and b) we need clear termination language to avoid complex refunds if they terminate early.
- Escalator: we prefer a fixed escalator (0–3%) rather than CPI to simplify the contract; we can cap it at 2.5%.

I've attached a recommended pricing matrix and a couple of sample billing schedules (redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx). Priyom / Karthik — can you confirm what we can approve vs what needs Neha's sign-off?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay ask — discount & billing split

Marissa / Priyom — thanks for the context. Finance notes and suggested route: 

- Accounting impact: Any multi-year prepay will be recognized monthly over the service term. Whether Nimbus pays 100% up front or 60/40 split, we'll record deferred revenue and amortize over 24 months. Splitting invoices is operationally fine but increases AR work and requires explicit milestone language in the SOW.
- Discount authority: Sales ops can approve up to 25% on a 2-year prepaid if contract term and ARR thresholds are met. Anything beyond 25% (up to 30%) needs Neha's approval and a short business case (ARR, ACV, logo strategic value).
- Proposed compromise: Offer 25% discount with a 70/30 invoice split (70% year 1, 30% year 2) and a capped escalator of 2.5% in year 2. Add a pro-rated refund clause for termination and a requirement that any refunds are offset against recognized revenue per ASC 606.

If Marketing/Revenue Ops want to be aggressive, we can table a 30% conditional discount that requires an upfront wire (no split) and a signed LOI within 5 business days.

--Karthik
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: 24-month prepay ask — discount & billing split

Folks — after reviewing the numbers and strategic fit, I authorize the following for Nimbus Health: 

- Approved discount: 25% off list for a 24-month prepaid commitment
- Billing structure: 70% invoice at contract execution (year 1), 30% invoice at start of year 2
- Escalator: capped at 2.5% for year 2 only
- Conditions: legal to add termination pro-rate & refund offset language; require signature on contract + payment terms (wire or ACH) documented in DocuSign.

Marissa / Priyom, please proceed to get legal review and send the finalized DocuSign. If they accept to pay 100% upfront in exchange for a deeper discount (30%), escalate to me with the ARR numbers and procurement timeline — I'll consider it.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep.rao@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 07:18:00 -0800
Subject: Final terms and next steps — 24-month prepaid (70/30)

Sandeep — thanks for the patience. Confirming the approved commercial terms below: 

1) Term: 24 months (start date on contract execution)
2) Discount: 25% off list for the committed term
3) Billing: 70% invoice at execution (covers year 1 consumption), 30% invoice at start of year 2
4) Escalator: 2.5% cap applied to year-2 pricing only
5) Conditions: Legal will add a pro-rated refund clause and refund-offset language per ASC 606; payment by wire preferred.

Next steps: I'll route the final SOW + contract to your legal and ours. Please review and sign via DocuSign (link below) once legal clears. We expect the DocuSign packet to include the SOW, pricing appendix, and the billing schedule.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature-request/ABCDEF123456

Attachments: redwood_pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, approval-email.pdf

If Nimbus can commit to a single upfront payment, we can revisit a 30% discount option — let us know by EOD Thursday next week and I'll escalate.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
